title: EIB Group 2025 Sustainability Report
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: The 2025 EIB Group Sustainability Report highlights how sustainability continues to shape the Group’s strategy, financing and operations. It marks an important milestone with the completion of the EIB Group’s first double materiality assessment, strengthening its alignment with evolving EU sustainability reporting requirements and providing a comprehensive view of its impacts, risks and opportunities across environmental, social and governance topics. In 2025, the EIB Group signed a record €100 billion in new financing, including €57 billion to advance the green transition. It reached record levels of investment in energy grids and storage, technological innovation, housing, and security and defence, helping to strengthen Europe’s competitiveness, resilience and strategic autonomy. The report shows how the Group’s investments are delivering tangible results: accelerating the green transition, improving access to clean water and sanitation, supporting affordable and sustainable housing, fostering innovation and strengthening social and territorial cohesion in Europe and beyond. As the EU climate bank, the EIB Group remains a global leader in sustainable finance and green bonds. The report also outlines how robust governance, accountability and ethical standards help ensure that financing delivers lasting benefits for people, communities and the environment. Against a rapidly changing geopolitical and environmental backdrop, the EIB Group continues to mobilise public and private investment in support of Europe’s priorities and a more sustainable future.
